english.title: Intentionally arrange / facilitate departure from UK / other country of a person with a view to their exploitation

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Asylum and Immigration Treatment of Claimants

english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[the United Kingdom]_
(B)_[another country, namely **(..SPECIFY THE COUNTRY..),]_

english.legislation: Contrary to section 4(1A)(c) and (5) of the Asylum and Immigration (Treatment of Claimants, etc.) Act 2004.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

the departure from the United Kingdom / another country
of an individual

exploit him / her after departure
in the United Kingdom / elsewhere

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 4(4) of the Act provides an exhaustive definition of conduct which would constitute exploitation for the purpose of this offence.
(ii) If trafficking is conducted with a view to sexual exploitation see H10937.
(iii) For the current offence wording, see H12167.

other.penalty:
Summary: Twelve months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Fourteen years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Note:
Until the commencement of section 154 of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 (c. 44) (increased limit on magistrates' power of imprisonment), sentencing shall have the effect as if the reference to twelve months were a reference to six months.

Time limit on prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
